Stopped publishers; read-only health inspection showed no OOM/restart, then re-read Pin/PinSentiment hashes to determine whether the request committed before retrying only missing rows. Resumed at most10 scores per serial request. Keep checkpoints and do not treat an HTTP failure as proof a write did not commit; no VM restart or deploy is needed for routine content recovery.

A later read-only Docker snapshot during October19 score recovery showed docker-app-1 StartedAt14:48:49Z and RestartCount1, whereas the earlier snapshot had RestartCount0/StartedAt14:32:08Z. Thus health can change between checks; distinguish that observed container restart from a restart performed by this session (none). Stop on502, reconcile saved records, and continue through authenticated APIs once healthy, without changing VM services.
